capacity_or_demand.prompt: Growing companies usually stall for one of two reasons. Which is holding you back more right now?

a.label: We can't take on more work, because we're at capacity

b.label: We could do more work, but we don't get enough customers

a.label: Too much depends on a few key people and what they know

b.label: Work is done by hand or differently every time, so it's slow

demand.prompt: What makes winning new customers hard?

a.label: Customers don't see clearly what we offer or why to choose us

b.label: We don't actively sell or market; work comes through existing contacts

key_person_dependency.name: Key-person dependency
key_person_dependency.current: Decisions and know-how sit with a few people.
key_person_dependency.target: Know-how is documented and shared, so work doesn't wait for them.

ideas.title: Log what waits for the key people
ideas.why: Seeing what piles up shows which know-how to share first.
ideas.first_step: For two weeks, log what waits for the key people.

ideas.title: Write down decisions and routines
ideas.why: Written rules let others decide without asking.
ideas.first_step: Write down the key people's most common decisions and routines.

ideas.title: Pair each key person with a second person
ideas.why: A second person who can step in removes the single point of failure.
ideas.first_step: Name a second person for each key person.

tasks.task: Map the tasks and know-how that depend on key people
Train a second person to handle them

manual_work.name: Manual ways of working
manual_work.current: Work is manual and done differently each time.
manual_work.target: A standard, measured process with automation where it pays off.

ideas.title: Find where work waits or gets redone
ideas.why: Waiting and rework are where the time goes.
ideas.first_step: Find the steps where work waits or gets redone.

ideas.title: Standardize the most common job
ideas.why: One standard way makes the work faster and easier to hand over.

ideas.title: Automate one repetitive task
ideas.why: A small automation shows quickly what pays off.

tasks.task: Map the workflow and find the bottlenecks
Standardize and document the main process
Introduce a tool or automation that tracks lead time and quality

unclear_offering.name: Unclear offering
unclear_offering.current: Every offer is tailor-made and hard to explain.
unclear_offering.target: A clear, packaged offering that's easy to buy.

ideas.title: Ask your best customers why they chose you
ideas.why: Their reasons are the core of what sets you apart.
ideas.first_step: Ask your best customers why they chose you.

ideas.title: Package your most common service or product
ideas.why: A package with a fixed scope and price is easier to buy.
ideas.first_step: Package your most common service or product.

ideas.title: Put the offer on one page
ideas.why: If it fits on one page, customers can understand it.
ideas.first_step: Put the offer on one page.

tasks.task: Analyse customers and competitors to define what sets you apart
Package the offering with scope and pricing
Create sales materials and website content for it

no_sales_process.name: No sales process
no_sales_process.current: Work comes only through existing contacts.
no_sales_process.target: A repeatable way to find and win new customers.

ideas.title: Describe your ideal customer
ideas.why: Knowing who to look for makes sales focused.

ideas.title: Track leads in a simple CRM
ideas.why: A tracked pipeline shows where deals stall.
ideas.first_step: Track leads in a simple CRM.

ideas.title: Contact ten new prospects a month
ideas.why: A steady rhythm turns sales into a habit.
ideas.first_step: Contact ten new prospects a month.

tasks.task: Set up a CRM and a sales pipeline
Plan and run the first outreach campaign
